name: RB transcriptional corepressor 1

function.text: RB1 encodes the retinoblastoma tumor-suppressor protein, which restrains E2F-dependent transcription and regulates progression from G1 into the DNA-synthesis phase of the cell cycle.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to retinoblastoma (autosomal dominant); hereditary retinoblastoma (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations are described across multiple tumor groups, including Liposarcoma; Osteosarcoma; Pineoblastoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

function.text: RB1 encodes the retinoblastoma tumor-suppressor protein, which restrains E2F-dependent transcription and regulates progression from G1 into the DNA-synthesis phase of the cell cycle.
